**[P2] Update the wrapper example to pass invocation metadata**

The wrapper-style example later in this section still calls `deriveExecutionTraceId` without the new fourth argument while claiming to join the plugin's trace. On LMI, that call can use a stale process header while the plugin uses `info.xRayTraceId`, splitting custom spans onto another trace. Rewrite that example around `wrapInvocation(info, ...)` and pass `info`; also update the earlier context-extractor description, which still says the extractor reads only `_X_AMZN_TRACE_ID`.
